statements.venue: Opening statement, House Education and Workforce HELP Subcommittee hearing "Building an AI-Ready America: Adopting AI at Work"
statements.quote: While some uses of this technology in the workplace show promise, it also poses significant dangers.
statements.context: As subcommittee ranking member he discussed AI in the workplace: retaliation against workers, privacy, discrimination and the power gap between workers and employers.
statements.source_label: House Education and Workforce Democrats press release
statements.reason: The dangers he describes are workplace harms (union retaliation, wage suppression, privacy, discrimination), not catastrophic risk from AI.
